verdict.rationale: Antigravity has its own extension mechanisms that can bring externally built capabilities into workflows: namespaced plugins that bundle skills, rules, MCP servers and hooks, plus downloadable skills. However, nothing in the evidence describes a partner program, a marketplace, or third-party partner-built agent apps as such. Missing for 10: a documented partner or third-party agent app ecosystem or marketplace, examples of partner-built agent apps, a workflow for installing them, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows

citations.quote: Plugins are namespaced bundles that allow you to extend Antigravity’s capabilities by grouping skills, rules, MCP servers, and hooks into a single package.
Create or download fully customizable skills to further your agent’s autonomy
Access plugins, MCP, skills, and hooks configurations instantly via slash commands
lets AI agents and editors securely connect to local developer tools, databases, file parsers, and external remote APIs
